Draw replayable case-control locations

Source: R/sampling_assignments.R
sample_controls.Rd

Creates explicit assignments. Scoring this table never samples again.

Usage

sample_controls(
  fix_tab,
  n = 20,
  subject = "subject",
  trial = "trial",
  stratify_by = NULL,
  replace = "auto",
  seed = 1,
  draws = 1,
  method = c("observed", "uniform", "map"),
  xbounds = NULL,
  ybounds = NULL,
  control_map = NULL,
  item = if ("item" %in% names(fix_tab)) "item" else NULL
)

Arguments

fix_tab

A flat fixation table with finite x/y and case metadata.

n

Number of controls per case.

subject, trial

Columns identifying subjects and trials (trial is nested within subject).

stratify_by

Additional columns restricting observed donor pools.

replace

"auto" uses replacement only if an observed pool is too small; alternatively TRUE or FALSE. Map controls always sample independently with replacement; replace = FALSE is an error for that method.

seed

Seed for assignment generation; restores the session RNG state. NULL explicitly uses the session RNG.

draws

Number of independent control draws.

method

Observed donor fixations, uniform coordinates, or grid locations sampled with probability proportional to a supplied map's nonnegative mass.

xbounds, ybounds

Explicit coordinate bounds for uniform controls.

control_map

A density map for method = "map".

item

Item column for observed donor exclusion. Defaults to "item" when that column exists, otherwise NULL. Pass another column name for custom item keys. NULL explicitly retains trial-only exclusion. Ignored for uniform/map controls.

Value

An eyesim_strata data frame. Metadata belongs to the case; x/y are the case or control coordinates. case_id and control_id index input rows (control_id is NA for generated locations); draw, stratum, and is_case identify assignments. Observed controls always exclude the case's trial and, when item is supplied, all trials of the case's item. The control_sources attribute retains input atomic metadata, indexed by control_id, so donor items remain identifiable after subsetting cases.

Details

There is no control-only jitter: perturbing controls but not cases changes their sampling distribution and can induce spurious preference. Uniform/map controls sample a different baseline from observed controls. Excluding the case's item avoids attenuating matched contrasts when items are presented repeatedly. Without item metadata only trial exclusion is possible. The resolved item column is recorded in the sampling attribute.
